description: Get an initiative with its crews, work items, lifetime spend, and daily burn-down series. By default (`shape: "summary"`) crews and work items are rows and initiative text longer than 1,000 characters (architect ADR, test plan, BRD) is excerpted and named in `excerptedFields`. Read one crew or work item in full with anyforge_get_crew / anyforge_get_work_item; pass `shape: "full"` only when you need every document, which can be very large. Reviewer verdicts (`architectVerdict`, `securityVerdict`, `qaVerdict`) come with `<field>Label`, the word the Console shows, and `<field>Outcome` (`clean`, `non_blocking` or `blocking`). `NEEDS_REVISION` is non-blocking and the Console labels it "Advisory"; the Console's "Needs revision" means the blocking `FAIL`.

shape.description: summary (default): rows and excerpts. full: every crew and work-item document in full.

name: anyforge_get_initiative
title: Get initiative
